info.description:
Fleet fuel management platform. Money is integer piastres, fuel volume is integer millilitres, timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. Every error has the ApiError shape, with a stable `code`.

**Trying it here.** Sign in with POST /api/v1/auth/login (company and station users) or /api/v1/admin/auth/login (Operations), finish two-step verification with /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify where asked, then press **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken` into `userToken`. A POS route needs a device token (`deviceToken`) and, for fuelings, the agent's session (`agentSession`) instead. Lists are paginated with `cursor` and `limit`.

approvalRequired.description: Above the threshold: a second person must approve before it posts

approvalThresholdPiastres.description: The threshold in force when it was recorded

bankAccountId.description: The verified bank account it was recorded for

decidedBy.description: Who approved or cancelled it; null for a payout that posted at once

clientTxnId.description: Generated by the device once per fueling; a retry sends the same id

fuelType.description: The fuel the agent selected; omitted means the vehicle's own

tagUid.description: The UID the reader returned, hex; spaces, colons and dashes are accepted

cooldownUntil.description: When the tag may fuel again; null on a replay

receiptPath.description: Path of the signed receipt link, under the API base

conflicts.description: Checks that failed when the server judged the capture; it is recorded all the same

receiptPath.description: Path of the signed receipt link, under the API base

agentId.description: The agent who captured it; must have had a session on this device at deviceAt

clientTxnId.description: Generated by the device when the fueling was captured; the same id every time it is sent

deviceAt.description: Device time of the fueling; the checks are judged at this instant

fuelType.description: The fuel the agent selected; omitted means the vehicle's own

tagUid.description: The UID the reader returned, hex; spaces, colons and dashes are accepted

unitPricePiastres.description: The price per litre the terminal showed; a different server price is flagged PRICE_MISMATCH

volumeMl.description: 1 ml to 1,500 L; outside that the item is REJECTED with INVALID_VOLUME

code.description: Why the item was rejected: TAG_NOT_RECOGNISED, AGENT_NOT_OF_STATION, CLIENT_TXN_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, INVALID_VOLUME or VALIDATION_FAILED; for RETRY, the server fault

fueling.description: The stored fueling, when recorded or duplicate

batchId.description: The device's own id for this batch, shown in the sync monitor; sending a batch again is safe

pending.description: How many captures the device still holds after this batch

results.description: One result per item, in the order the items were sent

companyId.description: The wallet's company (BALANCE_MISMATCH, MISSING_WALLET); null for a station payable

differencePiastres.description: Cached minus ledger; positive means the cache shows more than the ledger

stationId.description: The payable's station (PAYABLE_MISMATCH, MISSING_PAYABLE); null for a wallet

bankReference.description: The bank's transfer reference; one reference pays once

valueDate.description: The transfer's value date, at most 7 days ahead

amountPiastres.description: The amount that arrived, in piastres

bankReference.description: The reference on the bank statement

receivingAccount.description: Which ZAWED account received it (default MAIN)

transferDate.description: Value date, not in the future

effectiveFrom.description: Defaults to now; never in the past

endReason.description: SIGNED_OUT, SIGNED_IN_ELSEWHERE, EXPIRED, … ; null while open

endedAt.description: When it ended; null while it is still open

remaining.description: What the vehicle may still take in the period that contains serverTime

balanceAfterPiastres.description: The wallet balance right after this entry

direction.description: CREDIT adds to the wallet, DEBIT takes from it

sourceId.description: The top-up, fueling or payout id

payableHeld.description: Its payable was held at sync

active.description: The verified account payouts go to; null when there is none

pending.description: A change waiting for a second person; null when there is none

balancePiastres.description: What the platform owes the station; negative when the station owes the platform

heldPiastres.description: Offline fuelings held for Operations, not released and not reversed

pendingPayoutsPiastres.description: Payouts recorded and waiting for approval; a new payout may take at most available − this. Operations only: null in the station portal

balanceAfterPiastres.description: The payable right after this entry; negative when the station owes

direction.description: CREDIT raises what the station is owed (a fueling), DEBIT lowers it (a payout, a reversal)

fueling.description: The fueling of a FUELING entry, or the fueling a REVERSAL entry reverses

payout.description: The payout of a PAYOUT entry

sourceId.description: The fueling, payout or reversal id

debitsPiastres.description: Payouts and reversals debited in the period

from.description: Start of the period, inclusive; null from the first entry

now.description: The station's position now, whatever the period

openingPiastres.description: The payable just before the period

to.description: End of the period, exclusive; null up to now

uidLast4.description: Only the last four characters are ever returned

internal.description: Operations only: a note the company or station never sees

transferDate.description: Date of the transfer, not in the future

amountPiastres.description: What the company said it transferred (for OPS_RECORDED, what Operations recorded). Never what is credited

decidedBy.description: Who approved, rejected or cancelled it

requestedBy.description: Null when Operations recorded the transfer without a request

verifiedAmountPiastres.description: What arrived, as verified on the bank statement: the amount credited on approval

fleetCode.description: The company's own number for the vehicle; unique per company among vehicles in service

bankReference.description: The reference as it appears on the bank statement, when it differs from the requested one

evidenceReference.description: Where the evidence is: statement line, scan id, e-mail subject

receivedAmountPiastres.description: The amount that actually arrived, in piastres. This, never the company's figure, is what will be credited

receivingAccount.description: Which ZAWED account received it (default MAIN)

transferDate.description: The value date on the statement, when it differs from the requested one

reason.description: Why the wallet is credited without a bank transfer

agentSession.description: The agent's session from POST /api/v1/pos/agents/login, sent with the device token.
agentSession.name: X-Agent-Session

deviceToken.description: A POS device token from POST /api/v1/pos/token (signed with the device's own key, ADR 0010). Valid 15 minutes. A user token is never accepted here.

userToken.description: A user's access token: `accessToken` from POST /api/v1/auth/login (or /api/v1/admin/auth/login), after /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify for roles with two-step verification. Valid 15 minutes.
